verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the RESTful API for processing applicant data and documents, which suggests a programmatic way to retrieve your data before leaving. Nothing documents a dedicated export or exit path. missing for 10: a documented bulk/full-account data export, explicit open export formats (e.g., CSV/JSON), coverage of all data types (documents, checks, AML results, configs), offboarding/deletion guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
